properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued July 31 at 10:01PM CDT until July 31 at 10:30PM CDT by NWS Lubbock TX
properties.description:
At 1001 PM CDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from 7 miles northeast of Plainview to 5 miles west of
Lehman, moving southeast at 30 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...West Texas Mesonet.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Lubbock, Plainview, Levelland, Littlefield, Slaton, Floydada,
Abernathy, Hale Center, Olton, Morton, Crosbyton, Plains, Wolfforth,
Shallowater, Idalou, Ralls, Lockney, Sundown, Petersburg, and
Lorenzo.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued July 31 at 10:14PM CDT until July 31 at 11:15PM CDT by NWS Paducah KY
properties.description:
SVRPAH

The National Weather Service in Paducah has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Northeastern Bollinger County in southeastern Missouri...
Perry County in southeastern Missouri...
Northwestern Cape Girardeau County in southeastern Missouri...

* Until 1115 PM CDT.

* At 1013 PM CDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from Weingarten to near Womac to near Roselle, moving
southeast at 40 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and nickel size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Severe thunderstorms will be near...
Alliance around 1030 PM CDT.
Patton around 1035 PM CDT.
Perryville around 1040 PM CDT.
Daisy around 1050 PM CDT.
Millersville around 1055 PM CDT.

Other locations impacted by these severe thunderstorms include Old
Appleton, Glenallen, Silver Lake, Lithium, Longtown, Sedgewickville,
and Oak Ridge.

This includes Interstate 55 between Mile Markers 110 and 139.
properties.instruction:
Remain alert for a possible tornado! Tornadoes can develop quickly
from severe thunderstorms. If you spot a tornado go at once into the
basement or small central room in a sturdy structure.

For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued July 31 at 9:52PM CDT by NWS Corpus Christi TX
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Texas...

Nueces River Near Three Rivers affecting Live Oak County.

Nueces River Near Tilden affecting McMullen County.

For the Nueces River...including Tilden, Three Rivers...Major
flooding is forecast.

- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 39.2 feet
just after midnight tonight.
- Flood stage is 25.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 39.0
feet on 10/21/2013.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Even 6 inches of fast-moving flood water can knock you off your feet
and a depth of 2 feet will float your car. Never try to walk, swim,
or drive through such swift water. If you come upon flood waters,
stop, turn around and go another way.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/crp.

properties.headline: Tornado Warning issued July 31 at 10:18PM CDT until July 31 at 10:30PM CDT by NWS St Louis MO
properties.description:
At 1018 PM CDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located over Womac, or 11 miles northeast of Fredericktown,
moving east at 40 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage
to roofs, windows and vehicles will occur. Tree damage is
likely.

Locations impacted include...
Knob Lick, Libertyville, Mine La Motte, Coffman, Womac and Minnith.
properties.instruction:
Move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a well-built building
away from windows. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a
vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself
from flying debris.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued July 31 at 9:29PM CDT until August 1 at 5:00AM CDT by NWS St Louis MO
properties.description:
...The National Weather Service in St Louis has issued a Flood
Warning for the following rivers in Missouri...

Meramec River near Steelville.

River forecasts are based on observed precipitation and forecast
precipitation for the next 24 hours.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast due to heavy rain.

* WHERE...Meramec River near Steelville.

* WHEN...From this evening to late tonight.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 9:15 PM CDT Friday the stage was 10.2 feet.
- Forecast...No forecast is available for this location.
- Flood stage is 12.0 feet.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Rainfall heavier than forecast could cause river levels to rise even
higher than predicted. The National Weather Service will monitor this
developing situation and issue follow up statements as conditions
change.

This product, along with additional weather and stream information,
is available at https://water.noaa.gov/wfo/lsx

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued July 31 at 11:17PM EDT until August 1 at 12:15AM EDT by NWS Charleston SC
properties.description:
SMWCHS

The National Weather Service in Charleston has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Waters from Savannah GA to Altamaha Sound GA out 60 NM...

* Until 1215 AM EDT.

* At 1117 PM EDT, a strong thunderstorm was located over D R H Buoy,
moving east at 10 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts to 34 knots.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Small craft could be damaged in briefly higher winds and
suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Tug Rio Caroni, John Bird and D R H Buoy.
properties.instruction:
Boaters should seek safe harbor immediately until this storm passes.
Wind gusts 34 knots or greater, high waves, dangerous lightning, and
heavy rain are possible with this storm.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued July 31 at 8:50PM CDT until July 31 at 11:45PM CDT by NWS St Louis MO
properties.description:
FFWLSX

The National Weather Service in St Louis has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northern Crawford County in east central Missouri...
Northern Washington County in east central Missouri...

* Until 1145 PM CDT.

* At 850 PM CDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 2 and 3.5 inches of rain
have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 1 to 2 inches in 1 hour.
Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are possible in the
warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Sullivan, Cuba, Bourbon, Anthonies Mill, Leasburg, Richwoods, Old
Mines, St. Cloud and Oak Hill.

This includes the following State Parks...
Washington State Park and Onondaga Cave State Park.

This includes Interstate 44 in Missouri between exits 203 and 218.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.
